name.ja: ポケモンプラモコレクション BIG 02 イーブイ
name.en: Pokemon plastic model collection BIG 02 Eevee

description.ja: ポケモンの魅力を詰め込んだ、とにかく大きいプランモデル「ポケプラBIG」第二弾はイーブイ!!
description.en: The second model of the "Pokepla BIG", a big plan model packed with the charm of Pokemon, is Eevee!!

description.ja: ■全48パーツ、全長約20cm。組み立て簡単。最小限のシールで色分け再現。
description.en: • Total 48 parts, total length approximately 20cm. Easy assembly. Color-coded reproduction with minimal seals.

description.ja: ■いつまでも眺めていたくなるつぶらな瞳をクリアパーツの重ね合わせで表現。
description.en: • The round eyes that you'll want to stare at forever are expressed by layering clear parts.

description.ja: ■頭や耳、お尻が左右に可動することで表情豊かなポージングが可能。
description.en: • The head, ears, and butt can move left and right, allowing for expressive poses.

description.ja: ■触り心地にもこだわり肉球や舌には軟質素材を採用。
description.en: • We are particular about the feel of the product, and the paws and tongue are made of soft material.

description.ja: ■前脚と首周りの毛が前後に可動することで「タッチ」ポーズが再現可能。
description.en: • "Touch" poses can be recreated by moving the hair around the front legs and neck back and forth.
